Name: Happy Dou Dizhu
Author: IamJay05
Description:
星露谷斗地主 / Happy Dou Dizhu
在《星露谷物语》里真的打完一局[b]斗地主[/b]——不是贴图装饰，是能发牌、叫地主、出牌、结算的小游戏。
[line]
[heading]中文[/heading]
[b]是什么[/b]：把三人斗地主搬进鹈鹕镇。你和两个村民坐一桌，从叫分一路打到结算，[b]金币真的进出你的钱包[/b]。
[b]规则[/b]（腾讯官方经典规则）
[list]
[*]叫分 → 抢地主（每次 ×2）→ 加倍（不加 / ×2 / 超级加倍 ×4）→ 出牌 → 结算[/*]
[*]炸弹 ×2、王炸 ×2、明牌 ×2、春天 / 反春 ×2[/*]
[*]每手 [b]20 秒[/b]读条，超时自动代打；另有托管、明牌、提示、横扫连选、对手回合预选[/*]
[/list][b]对手[/b]：20 个鹈鹕镇村民轮着上桌。电脑会[b]记牌[/b]（每个点数出过几张），并按当前牌型换打法 —— 炸弹只留最大的、外面压不住的牌果断打、你剩一两张时不惜代价压。
[b]手感[/b]
[list]
[*]组合牌打出时先亮[b]大字[/b]（顺子 / 连对 / 飞机 / 三带一 / 四带二 / 炸弹 / 王炸）：逐字蹦出 → 砸下 → 屏幕震一下 → [b]牌才飞出来[/b]；演出期间回合计时停住，不会白扣你的时间[/*]
[*]结算时桌面按金额堆出金币，再加速飞进赢家口袋[/*]
[*]出牌飞落、发牌轮转、选中抬起[/*]
[/list][b]要求[/b]
[list]
[*]星露谷物语 [b]1.6+[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.0+[/b][/*]
[/list][b]安装[/b]：解压到 
[code]Mods/DDZ.HappyDouDiZhu[/code]，启动游戏。
[b]设置[/b]：15 项，其中音量、电脑节奏、音色可在 GMCM 里调。
[b]关于声音[/b]：发布版自带的是[b]作者自己合成的[/b] 10 个音效与配乐（无第三方素材）。如果你有自己收藏的斗地主语音包，把 
[code].ogg[/code] 按 
[code]assets/audio/manifest.json[/code] 里的名字放进 
[code]assets/audio/full/[/code] 就能用，模组会优先读 
[code].ogg[/code][url=https://v.douyin.com/q4awVqbS4P0/]https://v.douyin.com/q4awVqbS4P0/[/url]演示视频

[line]
[heading]English[/heading]
[b]What it is[/b]: three-seat Dou Dizhu (Fight the Landlord) inside Stardew Valley. You sit down with two villagers, play a full hand from bidding to settlement, and [b]gold actually moves in and out of your wallet[/b].
[b]Rules[/b] (classic Tencent rules)
[list]
[*]bid → rob landlord (×2 each) → double (none / ×2 / super ×4) → tricks → settlement[/*]
[*]bomb ×2, rocket ×2, reveal ×2, spring / anti-spring ×2[/*]
[*][b]20-second[/b] turn clock with auto-play when it expires; plus trustee mode, reveal, hint, drag-select and pre-selecting during opponents' turns[/*]
[/list][b]Opponents[/b]: 20 Pelican Town villagers rotate through the seats. They [b]count cards[/b] (how many of each rank are gone) and switch tactics per hand shape — keeping only the biggest bomb, dumping cards that can't be beaten, paying any price when you're down to one or two cards.
[b]Feel[/b]
[list]
[*]Combo plays trigger [b]big lettering first[/b] (straight / consecutive pairs / airplane / triple-with / four-with / bomb / rocket): characters land one by one → slam → screen shake → [b]then the cards fly out[/b]. The turn clock freezes during the performance so it never costs you time.[/*]
[*]At settlement, coins stack on the table by the amount, then fly into the winner's pocket[/*]
[*]Cards fly and land, dealing rotates, selections lift[/*]
[/list][b]Requires[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6+[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.0+[/b][/*]
[/list][b]Install[/b]: unzip into 
[code]Mods/DDZ.HappyDouDiZhu[/code] and launch.
[b]Config[/b]: 15 options; volume, AI pace and voice set are in GMCM.
[b]Audio note[/b]: this release ships [b]10 procedurally generated[/b] effects and music loops made by the author (no third-party assets). If you have your own Dizhu sound library, drop the 
[code].ogg[/code] files into 
[code]assets/audio/full/[/code] using the names in 
[code]assets/audio/manifest.json[/code] — the mod prefers 
[code].ogg[/code]
